Remove Image Metadata Online: Protect Your Digital Privacy

In today's digital age, every photo you take or share can contain hidden information known as metadata. This data, often invisible to the naked eye, can reveal sensitive details about you, your device, and even your location. Our free Remove Image Metadata tool empowers you to effortlessly strip this data, ensuring your privacy remains intact whenever you share images online.

Metadata, such as EXIF data, is automatically embedded into your photos by cameras and smartphones. While sometimes useful, it can also pose significant privacy risks, potentially exposing where and when a photo was taken, what device was used, and much more. By using our tool to strip EXIF data, you take control of your digital footprint.

What is Image Metadata (EXIF Data)?

Image metadata is a set of data embedded within an image file. The most common type is EXIF (Exchangeable Image File Format) data, which includes:

  • Date and Time: When the photo was taken.
  • Camera Settings: Make, model, lens, aperture, shutter speed, ISO.
  • Geolocation (GPS): Exact latitude and longitude where the photo was captured.
  • Image Dimensions: Resolution, orientation.
  • Copyright Information: If added by the photographer.

Other forms of metadata include IPTC (International Press Telecommunications Council) and XMP (Extensible Metadata Platform), often used by professional photographers for cataloging.

Why Remove Image Metadata?

The primary reason to remove image metadata is to safeguard your privacy and security. Sharing photos with embedded metadata can inadvertently:

  • Reveal your home address or frequent locations (via GPS data).
  • Expose personal details about your travel habits or daily routines.
  • Provide information about your specific camera or phone, which could be used for targeted attacks.
  • Lead to unintended data leakage when images are used in different contexts.

By using our online EXIF remover, you ensure that only the visual content of your image is shared, not the hidden personal data.

How to Strip EXIF Data with Our Free Online Tool

Our Remove Image Metadata tool is designed for simplicity and efficiency. You don't need any technical expertise to clean your photos. Follow these straightforward steps to strip EXIF data from your images:

  1. Upload Your Image: Click the 'Upload Image' button and select the image file (JPG, PNG) from your device. You can also drag and drop the file directly into the designated area.
  2. Process Instantly: Our tool automatically detects and removes all embedded metadata, including EXIF, GPS, and other hidden information. This process is instant and requires no further action from your side.
  3. Download Your Cleaned Image: Once the metadata is stripped, a new, clean version of your image will be available for download. It will retain its original quality but without any private data.

  • 100% Free to Use: No hidden costs, subscriptions, or limits on usage.
  • No Software Installation Required: Access and use the tool directly from your web browser on any device.
  • Privacy-Focused & Secure: We prioritize your privacy; selected images are processed securely and not uploaded to or stored by our server.
  • Supports Popular Image Formats: Works seamlessly with JPEG/JPG and PNG image files.
  • Maintains Image Quality: Your image quality remains untouched; only the metadata is removed.

Enhance Your Digital Privacy Today

What is URL Encoding and Decoding?

URL encoding, also known as Percent-encoding, is a mechanism for encoding information in a Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) under certain circumstances. It's a vital process in web development and data transmission to ensure that URLs remain valid and correctly interpreted by web servers and browsers. This process involves replacing unsafe ASCII characters with a "%" followed by two hexadecimal digits. Characters like spaces, question marks, ampersands, and slashes often need to be encoded as they have special meanings within a URL structure.

Why is URL Encoding Essential?

The primary reason for URL encoding is to prevent misinterpretation of special characters. For instance, a space character in a URL would typically terminate the URL string prematurely or cause an error. Encoding transforms it into "%20". Similarly, characters such as `&` (ampersand), `=` (equals sign), `?` (question mark), and `/` (forward slash) have reserved meanings in URLs. If they appear in a query parameter or path segment as data rather than separators, they must be encoded to preserve the URL's integrity and ensure accurate data transmission. Our free online URL Encoder/Decoder simplifies this complex process, allowing you to safely prepare or interpret URL components.

content:
Master Your Marketing Data with Our Free UTM Link Builder

In the world of digital marketing, understanding where your traffic comes from is paramount. Our powerful, free online UTM Link Builder is specifically designed to help marketers, agencies, and businesses accurately track the performance of their campaigns within Google Analytics. Stop guessing and start making data-driven decisions today!

UTM (Urchin Tracking Module) parameters are small, appended text strings that provide Google Analytics with vital information about the source, medium, and campaign associated with a particular link click. Without these parameters, your analytics data would be a jumble of direct and referral traffic, making it impossible to attribute success or failure to specific marketing efforts.

Our easy-to-use UTM Link Builder simplifies the process of creating these crucial tracking URLs, ensuring every click you generate provides actionable insights.

What is a UTM Link Builder and Why Do You Need It?

A UTM Link Builder is an intuitive web tool that automates the construction of tracking URLs. The tool then instantly generates a perfectly formatted URL, ready for deployment across all your digital channels.

You need a UTM Link Builder because:

  • It ensures data consistency in Google Analytics, providing a clear picture of campaign performance.
  • It allows you to pinpoint which specific ads, emails, or social posts are driving the most traffic and conversions.
  • It helps optimize your marketing budget by identifying underperforming channels and content.
  • It saves significant time and reduces the risk of human error compared to manual UTM creation.

How to Effortlessly Create Tracking URLs with Our Tool

Using our UTM Link Builder is incredibly simple, making advanced tracking accessible to everyone:

  • Step 1: Enter Your Destination URL: Begin by pasting the full URL of the page you want your users to land on (e.g., your product page, blog post, or landing page).
  • Step 2: Specify Campaign Source (utm_source): Identify the platform or origin of the traffic (e.g., "google", "facebook", "newsletter", "twitter", "blog"). This is a mandatory field.
  • Step 3: Specify Campaign Medium (utm_medium): Describe the marketing channel used (e.g., "cpc" for paid search, "social" for social media, "email" for email marketing, "referral" for affiliates). This is also mandatory.
  • Step 4: Specify Campaign Name (utm_campaign): Give your campaign a unique, descriptive name (e.g., "summer_sale_2024", "product_launch_q3", "evergreen_guide"). This helps you categorize your campaigns in analytics reports.
  • Step 5: (Optional) Add Campaign Term (utm_term): Primarily used for paid search campaigns, this identifies keywords for your ad.
  • Step 6: (Optional) Add Campaign Content (utm_content): Ideal for A/B testing, this differentiates between specific pieces of content or ads within the same campaign (e.g., "button_red", "text_ad_v1").
  • Step 7: Generate Your UTM Link: Click the "Generate Link" button. Your fully constructed, Google Analytics-ready tracking URL will instantly appear below the form.
  • Step 8: Copy and Deploy: Use the convenient "Copy" button to grab your new UTM link and deploy it across your chosen channels.

Why Our UTM Link Builder is Your Go-To Choice

While other tools exist, ours stands out for several compelling reasons:

  • Completely Free: No hidden costs, no premium features. Full functionality for everyone.
  • Intuitive & Fast: A clean, uncluttered interface designed for maximum efficiency and speed.
  • Accuracy Guaranteed: Eliminates syntax errors that can corrupt your analytics data.
  • Comprehensive Parameter Support: Supports all five standard UTM parameters for granular tracking.
  • Instant Results: Generate complex tracking URLs in mere seconds.
  • Always Online: Access it from any device, anywhere, anytime without software installation.

Empower your marketing efforts with precise data. Our free online UTM Link Builder is the ultimate tool for anyone serious about understanding and optimizing their digital campaigns.

faqs.q: What are UTM parameters and why are they important?
faqs.a: UTM (Urchin Tracking Module) parameters are tags you add to a URL. When someone clicks a link with these tags, they send data to Google Analytics, telling you where the user came from (source), how they got there (medium), and what campaign they were part of. They are crucial for accurately tracking campaign performance and making data-driven marketing decisions.

faqs.q: Which UTM parameters are mandatory?
faqs.a: While there are five standard UTM parameters (source, medium, campaign, term, content), Google Analytics generally requires only three for basic tracking: `utm_source`, `utm_medium`, and `utm_campaign`. For best practice, always include these three to ensure your data is categorized correctly.

faqs.q: Are UTM parameters case-sensitive?
faqs.a: Yes, UTM parameters are case-sensitive. For example, 'Facebook' and 'facebook' will be treated as two different sources in Google Analytics. To maintain clean and consistent data, it's highly recommended to use a consistent naming convention, typically all lowercase, for all your UTM parameters.

Unlike other UUID versions that might incorporate time or MAC addresses, Version 4 UUIDs are generated primarily from random or pseudo-random numbers. This characteristic makes them incredibly secure and highly collision-resistant, ensuring that each identifier is practically unique across all systems and time.

Why Use Our Online UUID Generator?

  4. Click the "Copy" button next to the generated UUID to quickly copy it to your clipboard for immediate use in your projects.

Understanding Version 4 UUIDs

While all UUIDs aim for global uniqueness, Version 4 UUIDs achieve this through randomness. This means that each UUID is independently generated, making it ideal for distributed systems where coordination between generators is impossible or undesirable. The structure of a Version 4 UUID includes specific bit patterns that identify it as version 4, with the rest of the bits filled by random data.

What Makes Version 4 UUIDs Secure?

The security of Version 4 UUIDs comes from the sheer size of the possible keyspace (2^122 unique UUIDs) and the quality of the random number generator used. The probability of two randomly generated Version 4 UUIDs colliding is so infinitesimally small that it's practically negligible even with a massive number of generated UUIDs. This makes them highly reliable for critical applications where uniqueness is paramount, preventing clashes in databases or identifying distinct entities across vast networks.

Common Use Cases for UUIDs

  • Database Primary Keys: Useful in distributed databases where auto-incrementing integers can lead to conflicts.
  • Session Identifiers: Securely track user sessions without predictable patterns.
  • Unique Object Identifiers: Assign unique IDs to various objects within an application, like files, users, or transactions.
  • API Request IDs: For logging and tracing individual API calls across microservices.
  • Distributed System Coordination: Identify messages or events in complex, asynchronous systems.

Online Hash Generator: MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512

Welcome to our comprehensive online Hash Generator, your go-to tool for swiftly creating cryptographic hashes. Whether you need to generate an MD5 checksum, a SHA-1 hash, or the more robust SHA-256 and SHA-512 values, our free and intuitive tool makes the process incredibly simple and efficient. Ideal for developers, system administrators, and anyone requiring data integrity verification, this tool provides a secure and reliable way to get the hash you need, whenever you need it.

What is a Cryptographic Hash Function?

A cryptographic hash function takes an input (or 'message') and returns a fixed-size alphanumeric string of bytes, known as a 'hash value' or 'digest'. The key characteristics of a good cryptographic hash function include:

  • Deterministic: The same input always produces the same output.
  • Quick Computation: It's fast to compute the hash value for any given input.
  • Pre-image Resistance: It's infeasible to reconstruct the input from its hash value.
  • Collision Resistance: It's infeasible to find two different inputs that produce the same hash value.

These properties make hash functions indispensable for data integrity checks, digital signatures, password storage, and various cryptographic applications.

Why Choose Our Hash Generator Tool?

We've designed our online Hash Generator to be the best for several reasons:

  • Multiple Algorithms Supported: Generate MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, and SHA-512 hashes all in one place.

  • User-Friendly Interface: A clean, simple design ensures ease of use for everyone.
  • Secure & Private: Your data is processed in your browser where possible and not uploaded to or stored by our server, ensuring your privacy and security.
  • Completely Free: Access all features without any cost or hidden fees.
  • No Downloads or Installations: Use it directly from your web browser on any device.

How to Use Our Hash Generator

Using our online hash generator is incredibly straightforward:

  1. Input Your Data: Simply type or paste the text, string, or data you wish to hash into the designated input field.
  2. Select Algorithms: Choose one or more hash algorithms (MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512) you want to generate.
  3. Generate Hashes: The tool will automatically calculate and display the corresponding hash values for your chosen algorithms.
  4. Copy & Use: Easily copy the generated hash values with a single click and use them for your specific needs.

Supported Hash Algorithms Explained

MD5 (Message-Digest Algorithm 5)

MD5 produces a 128-bit (32-character hexadecimal) hash value. While once widely used for data integrity checks and file checksums, it is now considered cryptographically broken for security-sensitive applications due to known vulnerabilities that allow for collisions. It's still suitable for non-security related checksums or as a unique identifier where collision resistance isn't critical.

SHA-1 (Secure Hash Algorithm 1)

SHA-1 generates a 160-bit (40-character hexadecimal) hash value. Similar to MD5, SHA-1 has also been demonstrated to be vulnerable to collision attacks, making it unsuitable for applications requiring strong security. Many modern systems have deprecated its use in favor of stronger alternatives.

SHA-256 (Secure Hash Algorithm 256)

Part of the SHA-2 family, SHA-256 produces a 256-bit (64-character hexadecimal) hash value. It is widely regarded as a secure hash algorithm and is extensively used in various applications, including blockchain technologies (like Bitcoin), SSL/TLS certificates, and digital signatures. It offers a much higher level of security compared to MD5 and SHA-1.

SHA-512 (Secure Hash Algorithm 512)

Also part of the SHA-2 family, SHA-512 generates a 512-bit (128-character hexadecimal) hash value. This algorithm provides an even higher level of security than SHA-256 and is generally used in applications where extremely robust collision resistance and pre-image resistance are paramount. It's ideal for high-security cryptographic operations.

This allows for most nested data to be represented in a readable tabular format, although very complex or deeply nested structures might require manual post-processing for optimal results.

What is Base64 Encoding and Why is it Useful for Images?

Base64 is a binary-to-text encoding scheme that represents binary data (like images) in an ASCII string format. Essentially, it takes your image data and converts it into a long sequence of characters that can be safely transmitted over media that do not handle binary data well, such as text-based protocols like HTTP (in certain contexts), email, or directly embedded within source code. For images, Base64 encoding is particularly useful for:

  • Embedding Small Images: Instead of making a separate HTTP request for each image, you can embed the Base64 string directly into your HTML, CSS, or JavaScript. This can reduce the number of HTTP requests, potentially speeding up page load times for small assets.
  • Email Signatures & Templates: Many email clients and services prefer embedded images via Base64 to ensure they display correctly without being blocked as external content.
  • CSS Sprites Alternatives: For small icons or background images, using Base64 can be an efficient alternative to traditional sprites.
  • Data URIs: Base64 encoded images are commonly used as Data URIs, allowing developers to include file content inline in web pages rather than linking to external resources.

title: Big Five Personality Test
desc: Take the free 50-item Big Five (OCEAN) assessment and get your openness, conscientiousness, extraversion, agreeableness and neuroticism profile.

seoDesc: Free Big Five (OCEAN) personality test with instant results. 50 scientifically inspired questions, no sign-up, 100% private - your answers never leave your browser.
content:
Free Big Five (OCEAN) Personality Test

The Big Five model is the most widely researched framework in modern personality psychology. Instead of sorting you into a single rigid type, it measures where you fall on five continuous dimensions: Openness (curiosity and creativity), Conscientiousness (discipline and organization), Extraversion (social energy), Agreeableness (empathy and cooperation), and Neuroticism (emotional reactivity and stress sensitivity).

How This Test Works

Answer 50 statements honestly - there are no right or wrong answers. Your responses are scored locally in your browser the moment you finish, producing a percentile-style profile for each of the five dimensions. Reverse-scored items are balanced automatically, and your results are never uploaded, stored, or shared.

What Your Profile Tells You

  • Openness: high scorers tend to be imaginative, curious and drawn to novelty; low scorers prefer the practical and familiar.
  • Conscientiousness: high scorers are organized, dependable and goal-directed; low scorers are more spontaneous and flexible.
  • Extraversion: high scorers recharge in social settings; low scorers prefer reflection and one-to-one depth over large groups.
  • Agreeableness: high scorers value harmony, trust and cooperation; low scorers are more competitive and skeptical.
  • Neuroticism: high scorers feel stress more intensely; low scorers are calmer and more resilient under pressure.

Why the Big Five Over Other Personality Quizzes?

Unlike four-letter type systems, the Big Five was derived from factor analysis of real personality data across languages and cultures, and its results are remarkably stable over time. It is the model used by researchers in psychology, organizational behavior, and behavioral science. Treat this as a self-reflection tool, not a clinical diagnosis or a hiring verdict - use it to understand your defaults, anticipate your blind spots, and communicate better with the people around you.

Private by Design

Everything runs locally in your browser. Your answers are never sent to a server, never stored in a database, and disappear when you close the tab. There is no account, no email gate, and no paywall.

faqs.q: Is the Big Five personality test scientifically valid?
faqs.a: The Big Five (OCEAN) is the most validated model in personality psychology, supported by decades of cross-cultural research. This free 50-item version is a well-regarded self-report screener, but it is not a clinical instrument and should not be used to diagnose mental health conditions.

faqs.q: How long does the test take?
faqs.a: Most people finish the 50 statements in 4 to 8 minutes. Answer with your first instinct rather than what you think sounds ideal - accuracy comes from honesty, not self-presentation.

faqs.q: Are my answers stored or sent anywhere?
faqs.a: No. All scoring happens locally in your browser using JavaScript. Nothing is transmitted, logged, or persisted, and closing the tab erases your answers.

faqs.q: Can my Big Five profile change over time?
faqs.a: Yes, modestly. Research shows traits drift gradually with age and life experience - conscientiousness and emotional stability tend to rise with maturity. Retaking the test every few years is a healthy habit.

faqs.q: What is the difference between the Big Five and MBTI?
faqs.a: The Big Five measures five continuous dimensions with strong psychometric support; MBTI sorts you into 16 discrete types and has weaker scientific backing. If you want a nuanced, evidence-based picture, the Big Five is the better tool.

title: Enneagram Test
desc: Discover your dominant Enneagram type (1-9) with this free 45-question test, including your wing and trait balance.
seoTitle: Enneagram Test: Free 9 Types Assessment with Wing (45 Questions)
seoDesc: Free Enneagram personality test - 45 questions, instant results for all 9 types plus your wing. 100% private, no sign-up, scored locally in your browser.
content:
Free Enneagram Personality Test

The Enneagram maps nine interconnected personality types, each defined by a core motivation, a deepest fear, and a habitual way of coping with the world. Unlike many personality quizzes, it focuses less on what you do and more on why you do it - making it especially useful for self-awareness, conflict resolution, and teamwork.

The Nine Enneagram Types

  • Type 1 - The Reformer: principled, purposeful, self-controlled, perfectionistic.
  • Type 2 - The Helper: generous, people-pleasing, warm, driven to be needed.
  • Type 3 - The Achiever: ambitious, adaptive, image-conscious, relentlessly productive.
  • Type 4 - The Individualist: sensitive, expressive, introspective, drawn to depth and meaning.
  • Type 5 - The Investigator: cerebral, private, observant, protecting energy and knowledge.
  • Type 6 - The Loyalist: committed, security-seeking, vigilant, worst-case planner.
  • Type 7 - The Enthusiast: spontaneous, optimistic, variety-seeking, reframing pain as possibility.
  • Type 8 - The Challenger: direct, decisive, protective, allergic to control by others.
  • Type 9 - The Peacemaker: easygoing, agreeable, conflict-avoiding, seeking inner and outer harmony.

How Your Result Is Calculated

The 45 statements in this test cover five items per type. After you answer, each type earns a raw score between 5 and 25, normalized to a 0-100 balance. The highest-scoring type is your dominant type, and the stronger of its two adjacent types on the Enneagram circle is shown as your wing (for example, a Type 5 wing 4, or 5w4). Runners-up are shown so you can see the full landscape of your motivations.

Use It Well

The Enneagram is a mirror, not a cage. Your dominant type describes your automatic patterns under stress and in comfort - growth happens by becoming aware of those patterns, not by being defined by them. For best results, answer quickly and honestly, and read the descriptions of your top two or three types rather than only the winner.

Private by Design

This test runs entirely in your browser. No answers are uploaded, stored, or shared, and you can retake it as often as you like with zero friction - no account, no email, no paywall.

faqs.q: How accurate is a free Enneagram test?
faqs.a: Online Enneagram tests are self-report screeners. They reliably surface your likely dominant type if you answer honestly, but the Enneagram itself is a typology rather than a clinical scale - treat the result as a strong hypothesis to explore, not a diagnosis.

faqs.q: What is an Enneagram wing?
faqs.a: Your wing is the adjacent type that most flavors your dominant type. A Type 9 with a Type 8 wing (9w8) is more assertive than a 9w1, who is more principled. Wings add nuance without changing your core motivation.

faqs.q: Can my Enneagram type change?
faqs.a: Your core type is generally stable, but your access to the healthier and less healthy expressions of every type shifts with stress, security, and personal growth. Many people type themselves differently after 30 because they have outgrown their autopilot patterns.

faqs.q: Are my answers stored or sent to a server?
faqs.a: No. Scoring happens locally in your browser with plain JavaScript. Nothing leaves your device, and no results are saved after you close the page.

faqs.q: Which Enneagram type is the best?
faqs.a: None. Every type has healthy, average, and stressed expressions. The point of the Enneagram is understanding your pattern so you can choose it consciously instead of being run by it unconsciously.

title: LLM Token Counter & Cost Estimator
desc: Estimate tokens for GPT, Claude, Gemini and DeepSeek prompts, and calculate input/output API cost before you hit send.
seoTitle: LLM Token Counter & Cost Calculator for GPT, Claude & Gemini
seoDesc: Free LLM token counter and cost estimator - paste any prompt to estimate tokens for GPT-5, Claude, Gemini and DeepSeek models and preview API cost instantly.
content:
Free LLM Token Counter & Cost Estimator

Every major model bills by the token, and every model slices text a little differently. This tool gives you an instant, offline estimate of how many tokens your prompt contains and what it will cost to run across GPT-5, Claude, Gemini and DeepSeek family models - before you commit a single API call.

How the Estimate Works

Counting real tokens requires each vendor's tokenizer, which is not practical to ship to the browser. Instead, this tool uses a calibrated heuristic based on the widely observed ratio of roughly 4 characters per token for English prose (about 0.75 tokens per word), adjusted per model family, with extra weight for punctuation and code, which tokenize less efficiently. Expect accuracy within about 10-15% of the provider's exact count - enough for budgeting, context-window planning, and comparing model costs.

What You Can Do

  • Paste any prompt, document, or code file and see characters, words, lines, bytes and estimated tokens live.
  • Compare input cost across GPT-5, GPT-5 mini, GPT-4.1, Claude Opus/Sonnet/Haiku, Gemini 2.5 Pro/Flash and DeepSeek.
  • Set an expected output length to estimate the full round-trip cost, or a total monthly budget projection.
  • Spot context-window overflow risk before sending oversized documents.

Pricing Disclaimer

Model prices change frequently and vary by tier, context length and batch usage. The prices built into this tool are indicative list prices per million tokens and may lag the provider's current rate card. Always confirm exact pricing on the vendor's official pricing page before committing production budgets.

Private by Design

Your prompt is processed entirely in your browser. Nothing is uploaded to a server, logged, or used to train any model - which is exactly what you want when the text you are counting is proprietary source code or confidential business data.

faqs.q: How accurate is the token count?
faqs.a: Within roughly 10-15% for English text. Code-heavy and CJK content tokenize less efficiently, so treat the number as a planning estimate. For exact counts, use the provider's official tokenizer (e.g. tiktoken for OpenAI models).

faqs.q: What is a token?
faqs.a: A token is the unit of text a model reads and bills for - roughly three quarters of a word in English. "1000 tokens" is about 750 words or about 4,000 characters.

faqs.q: Why are output tokens more expensive than input tokens?
faqs.a: Generating text is computationally more expensive than reading it - the model must run the full forward pass for every output token. Output prices are typically 3-5x input prices per million tokens.

faqs.q: Does this tool work offline?
faqs.a: Yes. All counting and cost math runs locally in your browser. Your prompt never leaves your device, making it safe for confidential or proprietary text.

faqs.q: Which models does it support?
faqs.a: GPT-5, GPT-5 mini, GPT-5 nano, GPT-4.1, Claude Opus 4.1, Claude Sonnet 4.5, Claude Haiku 4.5, Gemini 2.5 Pro, Gemini 2.5 Flash and DeepSeek V3. Provider prices are indicative and should be verified against official rate cards.

title: llms.txt Generator
desc: Generate a spec-compliant llms.txt so AI search engines and LLMs can understand, summarize and cite your website.
seoTitle: llms.txt Generator - Create an llms.txt for AI Crawlers Free
seoDesc: Free llms.txt generator - build a spec-compliant llms.txt in seconds so ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity can read and cite your site. Copy or download instantly.
content:
What Is llms.txt?

llms.txt is an emerging convention - like robots.txt for search engines - that gives large language models a clean, curated markdown map of your site. Instead of forcing an AI crawler to guess your information architecture, llms.txt tells it what your product is, which pages matter most, and where to find authoritative documentation. Sites that publish one are easier for AI answers, agents and IDE copilots to understand and cite accurately.

How to Use This Generator

  1. Site name and summary: one line that tells an LLM who you are and what you do - this becomes the H1 and the blockquote.
  2. Sections: group your most valuable pages - documentation, API references, pricing, about pages, policies, blog highlights - into named sections.
  3. Link entries: add a title, a URL, and an optional one-line description for each entry.
  4. Generate and publish: copy the output or download llms.txt and place it at https://yourdomain.com/llms.txt.

llms.txt vs robots.txt vs sitemap.xml

robots.txt controls what crawlers may access, sitemap.xml lists every indexable URL, and llms.txt is a human- and model-curated briefing: fewer pages, higher signal, written in markdown LLMs read natively. Use all three - they serve different readers. Pair this file with an AI Crawler robots.txt policy if you want to decide which AI bots may crawl at all.

Best Practices

  • Keep it under roughly 10,000 tokens - brevity is the entire point.
  • Link only canonical, stable pages; avoid filtered or paginated URLs.
  • Prefer descriptive link titles over raw URLs.
  • Re-generate it whenever your information architecture changes.
  • Verify it is reachable at /llms.txt without redirects or auth.

faqs.q: Is llms.txt an official standard?
faqs.a: It is a widely adopted community proposal published at llmstxt.org, not an IETF or W3C standard. Major AI products (Perplexity, Claude, ChatGPT browsing, IDE copilots) increasingly honor it, and it is inexpensive to publish and maintain.

faqs.q: Where should the llms.txt file live?
faqs.a: At the root of your domain - https://yourdomain.com/llms.txt - served as text/plain or text/markdown with no authentication or redirects. Some teams also publish an extended llms-full.txt with full documentation content.

faqs.q: Will llms.txt improve my Google rankings?
faqs.a: Not directly - it is not a traditional ranking factor. Its payoff is in AI answer engines and coding assistants, where being accurately understood and cited drives referral traffic and brand visibility in AI-generated responses.

faqs.q: What should I include in llms.txt?
faqs.a: Your product summary, then a handful of sections linking your documentation, API reference, pricing, about/contact pages and key blog posts - with one-line descriptions. Quality over quantity: 20 excellent links beat 200 mediocre ones.

title: AI Crawler robots.txt Generator
desc: Create a robots.txt that blocks or allows GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and 20+ AI crawlers - with one-click presets.
seoTitle: AI Crawler robots.txt Generator: Block GPTBot, ClaudeBot & More
seoDesc: Generate robots.txt rules for AI crawlers - GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, PerplexityBot, CCBot, Bytespider and more. Allow or block all in one click.
content:
Why You Need an AI Crawler Policy

AI companies crawl the web to build training sets and to ground answer engines. Whether you welcome that traffic or want to reserve your content for human readers is a legitimate business decision - but only if you express it. robots.txt is the standard mechanism crawlers check before fetching pages, and most major AI labs document that their bots honor it.

How This Generator Works

  1. Pick a preset: Block all AI crawlers, Allow all, or Custom to fine-tune each bot individually.
  2. Toggle individual bots: every major AI crawler is listed with the company behind it - OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Perplexity, Meta, ByteDance, Amazon, Apple, Common Crawl and more.
  3. Add your sitemap: optionally append a Sitemap: directive so compliant crawlers can still find your pages.
  4. Copy or download: paste the output into your existing robots.txt, or download it and upload it to your site root.

Bots This Tool Covers

GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, anthropic-ai, ClaudeBot, Claude-User, Claude-SearchBot, Google-Extended, GoogleOther, PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User, CCBot, Bytespider, Amazonbot, Applebot-Extended, meta-externalagent, Diffbot, cohere-ai and cohere-training-data-crawler - with links to each operator's documentation where available.

Important Caveats

  • robots.txt is voluntary for well-behaved crawlers; it does not technically prevent scraping. Combine it with rate limiting and terms of service for real enforcement.
  • Blocking GPTBot does not remove existing training data and does not affect Google Search impressions (Google-Extended is a separate control).
  • If you rely on AI referrals, consider allowing search-oriented bots (OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot) while blocking pure training crawlers.

faqs.q: Does robots.txt actually stop AI scraping?
faqs.a: It stops compliant AI crawlers - OpenAI, Anthropic, Perplexity, Apple, Amazon and Common Crawl all publish and honor their bot tokens. It cannot stop scrapers that ignore the standard, and it is not access control. For enforcement, combine robots.txt with WAF rules and terms of service.

faqs.q: What is the difference between GPTBot and OAI-SearchBot?
faqs.a: GPTBot collects data for potential model training. OAI-SearchBot indexes content to power ChatGPT's search answers. Blocking GPTBot opts out of training; allowing OAI-SearchBot keeps you eligible for ChatGPT search citations.

faqs.q: Should I block Google-Extended?
faqs.a: Google-Extended controls whether your content is used for Gemini model training and grounding - it does not affect your Google Search rankings or indexing. Block it if you want to withhold content from Gemini training; allow it if you want to be part of Gemini answers.

faqs.q: Where do I put the generated robots.txt file?
faqs.a: At the root of your domain - https://yourdomain.com/robots.txt - served as text/plain with no redirects. Merge new AI rules into an existing robots.txt rather than replacing directives your SEO already relies on.

faqs.q: Will blocking AI crawlers hurt my traffic?
faqs.a: It blocks AI answer engines and training - you may lose AI referrals and citations. Many publishers block training bots (CCBot, GPTBot) while allowing search bots (OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot) to keep AI visibility without feeding training corpora.

title: BMI Calculator
desc: Calculate BMI and your healthy weight range in metric or imperial units.
seoTitle: BMI Calculator: Free Body Mass Index & Healthy Weight Check
seoDesc: Calculate BMI in metric or imperial units. See your category, healthy weight range and BMI prime instantly. Free, private and browser-based.
content:
BMI Calculator: Understand Your Body Mass Index

Body mass index (BMI) is a quick screening measure that compares your weight with your height. This calculator shows your BMI, the standard adult category, a healthy weight range for your height and your BMI prime. Switch between metric and imperial units at any time; the result updates as you type.

BMI is useful for spotting broad weight trends across populations, but it is not a diagnosis. Muscle mass, body composition, pregnancy, age and ethnicity can all affect how a result should be interpreted. Use the number as a starting point for a conversation with a qualified clinician rather than as a target on its own.

How the Result Is Calculated

The calculator divides your weight in kilograms by the square of your height in metres. Adult categories are under 18.5 (underweight), 18.5 to 24.9 (normal weight), 25 to 29.9 (overweight) and 30 or above (obesity). Everything runs in your browser, so your measurements are never uploaded.

faqs.q: Is BMI accurate for everyone?
faqs.a: No. BMI is a population-level screening tool, not a direct measure of body fat or health. Athletes with high muscle mass can score as overweight, while older adults or people with low muscle mass can score as normal despite excess body fat. Pregnancy, children and some ethnic groups need different assessment methods.

faqs.q: What is a healthy BMI range for adults?
faqs.a: The World Health Organization uses 18.5 to 24.9 as the normal-weight range for adults. A result outside that range is not automatically a health problem, but it is a signal to look at the wider picture with a clinician.

faqs.q: Does this BMI calculator work in imperial units?
faqs.a: Yes. Switch to Imperial to enter height in feet and inches and weight in pounds. The calculator converts the values internally and shows the healthy weight range in pounds.

faqs.q: Are BMI thresholds the same for men and women?
faqs.a: The standard adult thresholds are the same, but body composition differs between men and women. BMI should therefore be interpreted alongside waist circumference, medical history and other health measures.

title: Calorie & Macro Calculator
desc: Estimate daily calories and protein, carb and fat targets from your goals.
seoTitle: Calorie & Macro Calculator: TDEE, BMR & Daily Targets
seoDesc: Estimate BMR, maintenance calories, a goal-adjusted daily target and protein, carb and fat macros with the Mifflin-St Jeor equation.
content:
Calorie & Macro Calculator: Build a Daily Target

This calculator estimates your basal metabolic rate (BMR), maintenance calories (TDEE) and a goal-adjusted daily calorie target. It then splits that target into protein, carbohydrate and fat grams using a macro ratio you choose. Enter your sex, age, height, weight, activity level and goal in metric or imperial units.

The estimate uses the Mifflin-St Jeor equation, one of the most widely used BMR formulas, multiplied by an activity factor. Real energy needs vary with genetics, training history, sleep, medication and how accurately portions are measured, so treat the result as a starting point and adjust based on two to four weeks of real-world results.

Safety and Accuracy

Very low calorie targets can be unsafe without supervision. The tool warns when a target falls below common minimums, but it cannot account for medical conditions, pregnancy or eating disorders. Speak to a registered dietitian or clinician before making large dietary changes.

faqs.q: How are daily calories calculated?
faqs.a: The tool uses the Mifflin-St Jeor equation to estimate BMR, multiplies it by an activity factor to estimate maintenance calories, then applies the surplus or deficit for your selected goal. One kilogram of body weight is roughly equivalent to 7,700 kcal, so a 0.5 kg weekly loss implies about a 500 kcal daily deficit.

faqs.q: Which macro split should I choose?
faqs.a: Balanced (30% protein, 40% carbs, 30% fat) is a reasonable default for most people. High protein can help with satiety and muscle retention during a deficit, lower carb can suit preference or blood-sugar management, and lower fat can help with high-volume eating. The best split is one you can sustain.

faqs.q: Is this calculator medical advice?
faqs.a: No. It is an educational estimate, not a prescription. Medical conditions, medication, pregnancy and a history of disordered eating all change what is appropriate. Consult a qualified professional for personalised advice.

faqs.q: Why is my calorie target below 1,200 or 1,500 kcal?
faqs.a: That usually happens with a small body size, a low activity level or an aggressive deficit. The tool shows a warning because very low intakes can make it hard to meet nutrient needs. Choose a smaller deficit or seek professional guidance.

title: Tip Calculator
desc: Split a bill, choose a tip percentage and see the total per person.
seoTitle: Tip Calculator: Split Bills & Calculate Gratuity
seoDesc: Work out the tip, total and amount per person for any bill. Use quick presets or a custom percentage, split the bill and round up.
content:
Tip Calculator: Split Any Bill in Seconds

Enter the bill amount, choose a tip percentage and say how many people are sharing the cost. The calculator shows the tip, the final total and the amount each person owes, with an optional round-up so the total lands on a whole currency unit. Presets cover 10%, 15%, 18%, 20% and 25%, and you can type any custom percentage.

Seven currencies are supported, including USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, INR and JPY. The tool uses your browser’s locale formatting and runs entirely on your device, so bill amounts are never sent anywhere. Tipping customs vary widely, so use the percentage that matches the country and service you received.

Equal vs Itemised Splits

The calculator assumes an equal split. If one person ordered more than the others, calculate that person’s share separately or adjust the bill amount before splitting. For large groups, check whether the restaurant already added a service charge to avoid tipping twice.

faqs.q: Should I tip on the pre-tax or post-tax amount?
faqs.a: Customs vary. Many people tip on the pre-tax subtotal, while others use the final total for simplicity. The calculator applies the percentage to whatever bill amount you enter, so you can choose either approach.

faqs.q: How do I split a bill unevenly?
faqs.a: This tool performs an equal split. For uneven shares, calculate each person’s itemised subtotal and tip separately, or run the tool once per group with the relevant bill amount.

faqs.q: Can I use the calculator for currencies other than the US dollar?
faqs.a: Yes. Choose EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, INR or JPY from the currency menu. The result updates instantly and uses the correct decimal conventions for each currency.

faqs.q: What does the round-up option do?
faqs.a: It increases the total to the next whole currency unit and recalculates the tip from that total. This is handy when paying cash or when you want a simple amount per person.

title: JWT Decoder
desc: Decode JWT header and payload claims, check expiry and verify HS256 signatures.
seoTitle: JWT Decoder: Inspect Header, Payload & Verify HS256
seoDesc: Decode JWT header and payload claims, check exp, iat and nbf times, and verify HS256, HS384 or HS512 signatures locally in your browser.
content:
JWT Decoder: Inspect a JSON Web Token Safely

A JSON Web Token is three Base64URL-encoded parts separated by dots: a header, a payload and a signature. Paste a token to decode the header and payload as readable JSON, inspect registered claims such as exp, iat, nbf, iss, aud, sub and jti, and see when the token expires relative to now.

Decoding is not verification. A readable token can still be forged or altered. For HMAC-signed tokens, enter the shared secret and choose HS256, HS384 or HS512 to verify the signature with the browser’s Web Crypto API. RS256 and ES256 tokens can be decoded here but require a public key or JWKS endpoint for proper verification.

Privacy and Security

Everything happens in this browser tab; the token and secret are never sent to a server. Avoid pasting production tokens into any page you do not trust, and never treat decoded claims as trusted identity until the signature, issuer, audience and expiry have all been validated by your application.

faqs.q: Does decoding a JWT prove it is valid?
faqs.a: No. Decoding only converts Base64URL text into JSON. A token could be expired, forged or signed with a different key and still decode perfectly. You must verify the signature and validate the issuer, audience, expiry and not-before claims before trusting it.

faqs.q: Is it safe to paste a JWT into this tool?
faqs.a: The token is decoded locally with JavaScript and is not uploaded. That said, JWTs can contain sensitive claims, so use a test token when possible and avoid pasting long-lived production credentials into any browser tool.

faqs.q: Why can I not verify RS256 or ES256 tokens here?
faqs.a: Asymmetric verification needs the issuer’s public key or a JWKS document plus algorithm-specific handling. This tool focuses on HMAC verification, which only needs a shared secret. Use your identity provider or a JWKS-aware verifier for RS256 and ES256.

faqs.q: What do exp, iat and nbf mean?
faqs.a: exp is the expiry time, iat is when the token was issued and nbf is the earliest time it may be accepted. All three are Unix timestamps in seconds. The claims table converts them to local dates and shows whether they are in the past or future.

title: Unix Timestamp Converter
desc: Convert Unix timestamps to dates and dates to seconds or milliseconds.
seoTitle: Unix Timestamp Converter: Epoch to Date & Back
seoDesc: Convert Unix epoch timestamps to readable dates and dates back to seconds or milliseconds. Shows local time, UTC, ISO 8601 and relative time.
content:
Unix Timestamp Converter: Epoch to Date and Back

Unix time counts the seconds elapsed since 1 January 1970 at 00:00:00 UTC, excluding leap seconds. This converter turns an epoch value into local time, UTC, ISO 8601 and a relative phrase such as “3 hours ago”, and it converts a local date and time back into seconds and milliseconds.

Automatic unit detection treats values with 13 or more digits as milliseconds, which covers current dates. You can also force seconds or milliseconds when working with older or synthetic data. A live clock at the top always shows the current epoch second, and one click copies it to the clipboard.

Why Timestamps Matter

Epoch values are compact, timezone-independent and easy to store in databases and APIs. They appear in JWT claims, logs, cache headers, cron schedules and event streams. Converting them correctly avoids off-by-a-thousand errors when a system expects milliseconds instead of seconds. All conversion happens locally in your browser.

faqs.q: What is Unix time?
faqs.a: Unix time, also called epoch time, is the number of seconds since 1 January 1970 at 00:00:00 UTC. It is timezone-independent, which makes it convenient for databases, APIs and logs. The same instant displays differently depending on the viewer’s local timezone.

faqs.q: How do I tell seconds from milliseconds?
faqs.a: Current Unix timestamps in seconds have 10 digits, while millisecond timestamps have 13. Automatic detection in this tool uses that pattern. Values around 1.7 billion are seconds; values around 1.7 trillion are milliseconds.

faqs.q: Does the converter handle dates before 1970?
faqs.a: Yes. Negative timestamps represent dates before the Unix epoch. Enter a negative value and the converter will show the corresponding local, UTC and ISO date.

faqs.q: Which timezone is used for the output?
faqs.a: The timestamp is an absolute instant, so the tool shows it in both your browser’s local timezone and UTC. The date-to-timestamp input is interpreted in your local timezone, which is the same behaviour as JavaScript’s Date parsing.

title: Readability Checker
desc: Score your text with Flesch-Kincaid, Gunning Fog, SMOG and more.
seoTitle: Readability Checker: Flesch-Kincaid, Fog & SMOG
seoDesc: Paste English text to get Flesch Reading Ease, Flesch-Kincaid grade, Gunning Fog, SMOG, Coleman-Liau and reading time. Runs locally.
content:
Readability Checker: Make Your Writing Easier to Read

Paste an article, email, essay or landing page and this tool calculates six established readability formulas: Flesch Reading Ease, Flesch-Kincaid Grade, Gunning Fog, SMOG, Coleman-Liau and the Automated Readability Index, plus average sentence length, syllables per word and estimated reading time.

Readability scores are guides, not grades. A technical document for specialists can legitimately score as difficult, while a children’s story should usually score as very easy. Use the scores to spot long sentences, dense vocabulary and paragraphs that ask too much of the reader, then revise with your actual audience in mind.

How to Improve a Score

Shorten sentences, replace rare words with common alternatives, break long paragraphs and use active voice. Keep necessary technical terms but define them on first use. The tool works on English prose because the underlying formulas rely on English syllable and sentence patterns; results for other languages are not meaningful.

faqs.q: What is a good Flesch Reading Ease score?
faqs.a: For general web content, 60 to 70 is a practical target. Scores of 80 or above are very easy, 50 to 59 is fairly difficult and below 30 is very difficult. The right target depends on the audience and subject matter.

faqs.q: Which readability formula should I use?
faqs.a: Flesch Reading Ease is intuitive for general audiences, Flesch-Kincaid Grade maps roughly to US school grades, Gunning Fog highlights complex words, and SMOG is often used for health communication. Looking at several scores together is more useful than optimising one number.

faqs.q: Does the checker work for languages other than English?
faqs.a: The formulas are designed for English. Syllable counting and sentence segmentation behave differently in other languages, so the scores would be unreliable. Use a language-specific readability tool instead.

faqs.q: Why do names and technical terms skew the result?
faqs.a: The syllable counter uses a heuristic that does not know every proper noun or abbreviation. Long names, acronyms and hyphenated technical terms can inflate the syllable count. Treat the result as an estimate and review passages in context.

title: Text to Speech
desc: Read text aloud with adjustable voice, speed, pitch and volume.
seoTitle: Text to Speech Online: Natural Voice Reader
seoDesc: Read any text aloud with browser voices. Adjust speed, pitch and volume, then play, pause or stop. No signup and no text uploads.
content:
Text to Speech: Listen to Any Text in Your Browser

Paste an article, study note, script or document and let your browser read it aloud. Choose from the voices installed on your device, then adjust speed, pitch and volume to suit the content. Playback can be paused, resumed and stopped at any time.

The tool uses the Web Speech API, so the text is processed by your browser’s speech engine rather than uploaded to a server. Voice quality and availability depend on the operating system and browser; some voices are generated locally, while others may use a cloud service provided by the browser or OS vendor.

Practical Uses

Text to speech is useful for proofreading, accessibility, language practice, hands-free reading and turning short scripts into rough audio drafts. It is not a replacement for professional narration, and the tool does not record or export audio files. For long documents, split the text into sections so you can pause and resume more easily.

faqs.q: Is my text uploaded to a server?
faqs.a: The page passes your text to the browser’s speech synthesis engine and does not send it to 100ToolCrate. Depending on the voice selected, the browser or operating system may use a cloud voice service under its own privacy policy. Local voices keep everything on your device.

faqs.q: Can I download the generated audio?
faqs.a: This tool does not record or export audio. It plays speech through your device’s audio output. If you need a downloadable file, use a dedicated recorder or a text-to-speech service that supports audio export.

faqs.q: Why do I see different voices on another device?
faqs.a: Voices are supplied by the operating system and browser, not by this website. A Windows laptop, an iPhone and a Linux desktop will usually expose different voice lists and languages.

faqs.q: Does text to speech work offline?
faqs.a: It can, if your browser and operating system provide local voices. Some voices require an internet connection because they are generated by a cloud service. Test the selected voice before relying on it offline.

title: Color Palette Generator
desc: Generate harmonious color palettes and copy HEX, CSS or JSON values.
seoTitle: Color Palette Generator: Harmonious HEX Palettes
seoDesc: Create analogous, complementary, triadic, tetradic and monochromatic palettes from any base colour. Copy HEX values, CSS variables or JSON.
content:
Color Palette Generator: Build a Coherent Palette

Start with a brand colour, a colour from a photograph or a random hue, then choose a harmony rule. The generator produces five coordinated swatches using analogous, complementary, triadic, tetradic, split-complementary, monochromatic or shade relationships. Click any swatch to copy its HEX value, or copy the whole set as CSS custom properties or JSON.

Palettes are generated mathematically in HSL colour space, which makes the relationships predictable and easy to adjust. That is different from the Image Palette Generator, which extracts the dominant colours from an uploaded photo. Use this tool when you already have a base colour and need a matching set for a website, slide deck or brand exploration.

From Palette to Interface

Test the colours against real text and backgrounds before committing. A palette can look balanced as swatches but fail contrast requirements in buttons, links or small labels. Pair the generator with a contrast checker and define semantic roles such as primary, surface, muted and danger instead of using colours arbitrarily.

faqs.q: Are the generated palettes accessible?
faqs.a: Not automatically. The tool creates harmonious colour relationships, but accessibility depends on how the colours are paired and on contrast ratios. Check text and background combinations with a WCAG contrast checker before shipping an interface.

faqs.q: Can I export a palette?
faqs.a: Yes. Copy the five HEX values as CSS custom properties or as JSON. Individual swatches can also be clicked to copy a single HEX code.

faqs.q: Which colour harmonies are included?
faqs.a: Analogous, complementary, triadic, tetradic, split-complementary, monochromatic and shades. Each produces five swatches from the same base colour.

faqs.q: Can I extract colours from an image?
faqs.a: Use the separate Image Palette Generator for that. This tool starts from a HEX colour and generates harmony-based palettes mathematically.

title: Pomodoro Timer
desc: Focus in custom sessions with short and long breaks built in.
seoTitle: Pomodoro Timer Online: 25/5 Focus Sessions
seoDesc: A free online Pomodoro timer with custom focus and break lengths, automatic cycles, session counts and a completion chime.
content:
Pomodoro Timer: Focus in Short, Repeatable Blocks

The Pomodoro technique breaks work into focused intervals, traditionally 25 minutes, separated by short breaks. After four focus sessions you take a longer break. This timer implements that cycle with adjustable focus, short-break and long-break lengths, a session counter and an optional automatic start for the next interval.

The countdown is based on an end timestamp rather than a simple tick counter, so it catches up correctly if the tab is backgrounded or the device briefly sleeps. A chime plays when each interval ends. Everything runs in the browser; no account, timer server or notification permission is required.

Getting the Most From It

Decide on one task before starting a session, close unrelated tabs and keep the timer visible if you find that helpful. Use the break to stand up, look away from the screen and reset your attention. If 25 minutes feels too long, start with 15 or 20 and increase gradually.

faqs.q: What is the Pomodoro technique?
faqs.a: It is a time-management method created by Francesco Cirillo. You work on one task for a fixed interval (usually 25 minutes), take a short break, and repeat. After four focus sessions, you take a longer break. The rhythm makes sustained focus easier to start and easier to measure.

faqs.q: Does the timer keep running in the background?
faqs.a: The timer stores an end timestamp, so it calculates the correct remaining time when the tab becomes active again. Browsers may throttle background timers, which can delay the chime, so keeping the tab open and audible gives the most reliable experience.

faqs.q: Can I customise the focus and break lengths?
faqs.a: Yes. Change the focus, short-break and long-break minutes, and choose how many focus sessions trigger a long break. The new values apply to the next interval and to the current interval when it is not running.

faqs.q: Does it send notifications?
faqs.a: No. It plays a short chime through the Web Audio API when an interval ends. The tool does not request system notification permission.

title: Typing Speed Test
desc: Measure your WPM and accuracy in a timed typing test.
seoTitle: Typing Speed Test: Check WPM & Accuracy Online
seoDesc: Take a 15, 30, 60 or 120-second typing test. See live WPM, accuracy and errors, then review your final score. No signup required.
content:
Typing Speed Test: Measure WPM and Accuracy

Choose a 15, 30, 60 or 120-second test and start typing the passage. The timer begins with your first keystroke, and live statistics show net words per minute, accuracy and the number of incorrect characters. When the time runs out, you get a final result with net WPM, raw WPM, accuracy and characters typed.

Net WPM is calculated as correct characters divided by five, divided by elapsed minutes. Accuracy is the share of typed characters that match the target passage. Paste and drop are disabled so the result reflects actual typing rather than copied text. The test uses a randomised set of common English words and runs entirely in your browser.

What Is a Good Typing Speed?

Around 40 WPM is a common working speed, 60 WPM is comfortable for most professional roles and 80 WPM or more is fast. Accuracy matters as much as raw speed: a fast result with many errors creates more correction work. Practise with relaxed hands, look at the screen rather than the keyboard and aim for steady rhythm.

faqs.q: How is WPM calculated?
faqs.a: Net WPM uses correct characters only: correct characters divided by five, then divided by the elapsed time in minutes. Raw WPM uses every typed character. This is why accuracy has a direct effect on your net score.

faqs.q: Why is paste disabled?
faqs.a: Pasting would bypass typing and make the result meaningless. The test blocks paste and drag-and-drop so the score reflects your actual keystrokes.

faqs.q: What is a good typing speed?
faqs.a: About 40 WPM is a typical working speed, 60 WPM is comfortable for most office roles and 80 WPM or above is fast. Accuracy above 95% is usually more valuable than a small gain in raw speed.

faqs.q: Does the test work on phones and tablets?
faqs.a: Yes, but an on-screen keyboard behaves differently from a physical keyboard and usually produces lower scores. For a comparable result, use a desktop or laptop with a physical keyboard.

title: Online Notepad
desc: A distraction-free notepad that autosaves in your browser.
seoTitle: Online Notepad: Autosaving, Private Text Editor
seoDesc: Write notes in a distraction-free browser editor with autosave, word count, copy and .txt download. Your text stays on your device.
content:
Online Notepad: A Clean Place to Write

This notepad opens with a single editor, a file name and a few essential actions. There is no account, toolbar clutter or formatting to manage. Text autosaves to your browser’s local storage after you stop typing, and the status line shows when the note was last saved. Word, character and line counts update as you write.

Use the copy button to move text into another app, or download the note as a plain .txt file for a portable backup. The clear action removes the note from the editor and from local storage. Everything stays on this device; no text is sent to a server.

Privacy and Backups

Local storage is convenient but not permanent. Clearing browser data, using private browsing or switching devices will make the note unavailable. Download important notes regularly, and do not use a browser notepad for passwords, recovery codes or other secrets you would not store on the device.

faqs.q: Where are my notes saved?
faqs.a: Notes are stored in your browser’s local storage on this device. They are not uploaded to 100ToolCrate or synced between devices. Clearing site data or using private browsing will remove or hide the saved note.

faqs.q: Is the notepad private?
faqs.a: Your text is not transmitted to a server, but it is readable by anyone who can access this browser profile and device. Do not use it for passwords, recovery codes, financial details or other sensitive secrets.

faqs.q: How do I back up a note?
faqs.a: Use the Download .txt button to save a plain-text copy to your device. You can also copy the text into another editor or cloud document that you control.

faqs.q: Why did my note disappear?
faqs.a: Local storage can be cleared by browser settings, privacy tools, private browsing or a different browser profile. Download important notes and keep your own backup.
